questions: Python evaluates the addition before printing.

exercises.title: Variables and types
questions: After score = 10 and score = score + 5, what is score?

exam: What is the type of True?
After total = 4 and total = total * 3, what does print(total) display?

title: Strings and collections
summary: Format text and organize values in lists.

questions: upper() converts every letter to uppercase.
Which expression inserts name into a greeting?

exam: With name = "Sai", what does f"Hi {name}" produce?

title: Logic and reusable code
summary: Make decisions, repeat tasks, and write functions.

exercises.title: Conditions and loops
questions: >= means greater than or equal to.
How many iterations does for n in [1, 2, 3] perform?
A for loop visits each list element once.

exercises.title: Reusable functions
questions: Use def followed by the function name and parameters.
Sends a result back to the caller
return passes the result to the calling code.

exam: How many times does print(n) run in for n in [4, 5]?
